summary: Iteration 69: Tested Parent Concerns & Booster Lessons Management feature. All 23 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified page loading, summary cards, tabs, concern creation with searchable student dropdown, booster lesson creation with searchable student/teacher dropdowns, and sidebar navigation. Teacher's My Classes page correctly shows Support button only when booster data exists for a class.
